Gaurav Yadav to continue as Punjab Police chief

Gaurav Yadav is likely to continue as the Director General of Police (DGP) for Punjab. The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has shortlisted his name as part of a three-member panel. This development indicates continuity in the state's police leadership.
